title: Charge the joint innovation needed for nearly shared noisy means
statement: For L>0 and all scalar L-Lipschitz sources,no finite uniform every-execution value cap can approximate the perfect-common-noise pair(m_g(0)+SZ,m_g(2)+SZ) in TV below1. With independent innovation nu per marginal and n>=1,uniform error obeys2epsilon+1/4>=2Phi(s_min/(2sqrt(2)nu))-1,s_min=c0L/(256n^2),c0=phi(9/16)-phi(23/16)>0. In particular nu<=c0L/(1024sqrt(2)n^2) forces epsilon>.352.

L>0,uniformly all legal scalar Lipschitz sources and deterministic query cap
All shared/independent Gaussian noise coefficients explicitly budgeted
provides: Adaptive zero-transcript bump support hit probability<=4n delta
Continuous unknown amplitude makes exact mean-difference support inaccessible on a miss
Near-perfect correlation rho with marginal sigma pays n>sqrt(c0L/(1024sqrt(2)sigma))*(1-rho)^(-1/4) for the stated smaller error

No lower bound on general N687 single-output sampling
costs: Every failed bump-search query and required independent innovation paid
Finite uniform cap,not merely expected queries,is the premise
